problem_title: Convexity of the Le Roy parameter threshold

evidence.text:
For every gamma>1, the literal positive-admissibility threshold in Simon's paper is convex on (0,1/gamma). Rescaling expresses it as a supremum of positive perspectives; finiteness and positivity identify that supremum with the source infimum. This resolves the separate threshold-convexity question at the end of Section 3.
